Subject: lattice problems | ID: 41381

Lemma

If G is a compact group and pi: G -> GL(V) is a subharmonic representation, then V decomposes as a direct sum of irreducible representations.

Step 2. The ergodic operator \(Q_{01310012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01310012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The Holder operator \(B_{01310013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle B_{01310013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through algebraic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
